If ‘+’ means ‘−’, ‘−’ means ‘×’, ‘×’ means ‘÷’, and ‘÷’ means ‘+’, then what will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation?

54 − 2 ÷ 120 × 2 + 85 = ?

BODMAS Table:

 **Original Sign**
 **New Sign**

 ×

**Given Expression: **54 − 2 ÷ 120 × 2 + 85 = ?

After replacing the signs with their respective meanings, and following the BODMAS rule, 

**= 54 × 2 + 120 ÷ 2 − 85**

= __54 × 2__ + 60 − 85

=__108 + 60__ − 85

= __168 − 85__

= 83

Hence, the correct answer is "**option 4"**

questions.question: All 193 people are standing in a row facing north. Ccd is 14th from the right end while Vks is 124th from the left end. How many people are there between Ccd and Vks?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

 
• **Total number of people** standing in the row = 193
 
• Position of **Vks** from the **left end** = 124th
 
• Position of **Ccd** from the **right end** = 14th

 

**Position of Ccd from the left** = (**Total number of people** − Position of **Ccd** from the **right end**) + 1

= (193 − 14) + 1

= 179 + 1

= 180

 
• Position of **Vks** from the **left** = 124th
 
• Position of **Ccd** from the **left** = 180th
 
• Number of people between **Ccd** and **Vks** = (Position of **Ccd** from the **left** − Position of **Vks** from the **left**) − 1

= (180 − 124) − 1

= 56 − 1

= 55

Hence, the correct answer is **'Option 2'**.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into their constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(27, 12, 322)

(24, 13, 310)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: (First Number × Second Number) − 2 = Third Number**

For the first set **(27, 12, 322)**

⇒ (27 × 12) − 2

⇒ 324 − 2 = 322.

For the second set **(24, 13, 310)**

⇒ (24 × 13) − 2

⇒ 312 − 2 = 310.

Applying the same logic to the set **(31, 8, 246)**

⇒ (31 × 8) − 2

⇒ 248 − 2 = 246.

Hence, the correct answer is **'Option 4'**.

questions.question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

**Statements:**

All cherries are bats.

No bat is an orange.

**Conclusions:**

(I) No cherry is an orange.

(II) Some oranges are bats.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4d4c6123b2091a0d7102dcd4724f9c05a3a25e190e20ed4ae99726da3fe2cdef.png] 

**(I) No cherry is an orange - Follows**

Since all **cherries** are entirely inside the **bats** set, and the **bats** set has no intersection with **oranges**, it is impossible for any **cherry** to be an **orange**.

**(II) Some oranges are bats - Don't **Follows

The statement clearly specifies that no **bat** is an **orange**, which means the sets are completely disjoint; therefore, no **orange** can be a **bat**.

**Only conclusion (I) follows.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1"
